Arupi's patreon rewards (which has not been updated with new art since May 2025). This gallery does not intend to be a complete collection of the featured artist's works, it only contains the works that were posted on Patreon, not the ones that were only posted on other sites.

The images are posted in the oreder they were uploaded to patreon, first images are the oldest, last images are the newest.

Links:
https://arupi.carrd.co/ (contains links to the artists socials and websites, but they don't seem to be active in regards to posting new arts.)
